AI Architecture & Decision Pipeline Explainable AI
01
Hardware Telemetry Stream
Yale Smart Lock reports actuation voltage drop (ΔV), motor draw (mA), and lock cycle count via MQTT over TLS.
02
Rolling Gaussian Baseline (14-Day)
Computes continuous statistical mean (μ ≈ 12.2 mV) and standard deviation (σ ≈ 2.4 mV) across standard actuation cycles.
03
Z-Score Triage Engine (Z = [ΔV - μ] / σ)
Normal: Z < 2.0σ. Accelerated cell degradation flagged if Z ≥ 2.5σ over 3 consecutive actuations (distinguishing low battery from cell failure).
04
Closed-Loop Facilities Action
Generates automated preventive JKH work-order ticket before catastrophic lockout; includes 1-Tap resident manual override.
⚠️ Operational Limitations
  • Temperature Transients: Extreme cold snaps (< 15°C) temporarily elevate internal cell resistance; multi-cycle moving window prevents false triggers.
  • Warm-Up Threshold: Requires at least 15 actuations to establish baseline confidence (μ, σ) for newly installed lock hardware.
  • Hardware Scope: Telemetry observable only on motorized smart locks with micro-voltage sensing relays; passive mechanical deadbolts are excluded.
